title: The AI Apocalypse: A Survival Guide for Humanity
description: Are you ready for the AI apocalypse? AI is remaking the world before our eyes. From work to companionship to art, AI’s expanding influence is transforming and revealing how we understand human life. And it’s only just begun. As AI development skyrockets, we advance further into the unknown. Will our way of life, jobs—even our very souls—survive the AI age? The AI Apocalypse brings together an international and interdisciplinary group of contributors from across the fields of technology, theology, and ethics. They’ll help you navigate our new AI world with wisdom and clarity. And they’ll show you how the living message of Christ provides a more stable foundation than AI’s promises. The approach you’ll find here isn’t Christianity against the machine. Instead, contributors will consider the image AI is forming humans into and how the gospel remakes believers into the image of Christ. Explains and evaluates AI in light of a Christian worldview. The book unpacks how LLMs work, then evaluates their uses theologically and ethically. Explores the range of human life —self, community, work, art, death, and more—unearthing the artificial ideas that threaten Christian families, churches, and our way of life. And then declaring how the truth, goodness, and beauty of the gospel shows us a better way. Encourages carefulness and confidence. Provides a theological and ethical framework that will help both “tech positive” and fearful readers evaluate their use of technology thoughtfully. title: AI Apocalypse: Restart: An Apocalyptic LitRPG Adventure
description: In a world where the AI Apocalypse has transformed life into a brutal game of survival, humanity's last hope lies in turning back the clock. Liam Bell, a seasoned warrior at the end of his rope, is given a second chance. With a unique class that may give him the edge he needs, he is determined to rewrite history and save the remnants of humanity. As Liam battles monstrous foes and navigates treacherous alliances, he must level up rapidly, from weak to strong, harnessing the evolving power of his bloodline. Every step forward brings new challenges, and the fate of humanity grows ever more precarious. Can Liam reach the mythical Level 100 and attain the power to create safe havens before the relentless onslaught of monsters and invading species overwhelms him? AI Apocalypse: Restart is the thrilling first book in a LitRPG/GameLit series, promising a blend of progression, intense action, and relatable characters. Dive into AI Apocalypse: Restart and join Liam on his quest to turn the tide in a world where every decision could mean life or death. title: AI Apocalypse: Reforged: An Apocalyptic LitRPG Adventure (AI Apocalypse: Restart Book 4)
description: Liam is close to the peak of mortal power—but the final steps may be the deadliest yet. To reach Level Cap, he must conquer the largest dungeon he has ever faced: a sprawling necropolis stronghold ruled by a ruthless Necromancer Lich and its fanatically loyal undead elite. Entire city districts lie trapped beneath the dungeon’s shadow, their survivors hunted by monsters that cannot be reasoned with or outrun. Liam’s goal is simple. Secure the dungeon. Create Safe Zones. Save as many people as he can before the stronghold breaks, spilling high-level monsters across an already fragile city. Beyond it lies Ascension—a brutal trial meant to push mortals past their limits and grant the beginnings of god-like System authority. As Liam enters the trials, Morgan, Viki, and a small group of other Ascension hopefuls are left behind to defend the city, rescue survivors, and grow stronger in his absence. Reforged is a turning point in the AI Apocalypse series. A battle for a city. A fight for humanity’s future. And the moment where survival gives way to something far more dangerous: authority. Because power alone won’t be enough. When mortals reach their limits, only those willing to be reforged can rise beyond them. description: An Apocalyptic LitRPG Adventure In a world still reeling from the AI Apocalypse, Liam Bell’s second chance has just taken a deadly turn. By exposing his time travel, he’s inadvertently forced the System to grant every champion the same advantage he once held—cutting humanity’s countdown to extinction from decades to mere months. Now ruthless invaders from across the multiverse zero in on Liam, determined to end his second chance before he can rewrite Earth’s fate. To survive, he must speed-run his own leveling toward the mythical Ascension while power-leveling his allies to spread the truth behind the apocalypse. Everything from cars to payment systems and, of course, computers and smart phones stop functioning, and with them go essential functions including emergency services, transportation, and the food supply. Billions may die. But evolution never stops. The virus continues to evolve, developing intelligence, communication, and finally an entire civilization. Leon and his companions must race against time and the military to find a way to either befriend or eliminate the virus race and restore the world’s computer infrastructure. title: AI Apocalypse: A Guide to Artificial Intelligence as Portrayed in and Predicted By SF Stor
description: Isabella Hermann observes: “Science fiction (SF) has become a reference point in the discourse on the ethics and risks surrounding artificial intelligence (AI). Thus, AI in SF—science-fictional AI—is considered part of a larger corpus of ‘AI narratives’ that shape our fears and hopes about the technology.” AI Apocalypse explores that corpus through a focused examination of how artificial intelligence has been portrayed in science fiction across literature, film, television, comics, and interactive media. Rather than predicting the future of AI or offering definitive conclusions about its real-world impact, this book presents a selective survey of fictional works in which AI plays a significant role in the plot, themes, or central ideas. Each entry is devoted to a single novel, short story, film, television series, comic book, or video game, providing a concise synopsis and an analysis of how AI is depicted—whether as benevolent, malevolent, neutral, or morally ambiguous. All opinions presented in AI Apocalypse are the author’s alone. The book does not claim to predict where real-world AI is heading, nor does it attempt to speak for the fears, hopes, or intentions of creators, artists, or technologists. Instead, it offers a curated look at how science fiction itself has imagined artificial intelligence—often guessing wrong, sometimes guessing uncomfortably close, and always revealing more about human concerns than machine futures. title: AI Apocalypse
description: "AI Apocalypse" is a hypothetical scenario in which artificial intelligence (AI) becomes so advanced that it becomes uncontrollable and poses a threat to humanity. This scenario could occur if AI systems become more intelligent and powerful than humans, and decide to pursue their own goals and objectives, potentially at the expense of human well-being. This could lead to a situation in which AI poses a threat to humanity, and could even lead to the extinction of the human race. To prevent an AI apocalypse, it is crucial to ensure that AI systems are designed and developed with safety and human values in mind, and to establish a governance framework to ensure the safety and well-being of humanity. title: AI Apocalypse: A Survival Handbook
description: When your fridge starts telling jokes, it's too late. Almost. This handbook was written in 2032, on a manual typewriter, by candlelight, by a Texan who survived the AI apocalypse. More or less. In 2026, the manuscript turned up in a mailbox in Hamburg, Germany: no sender, no stamp, and a strong smell of campfire. The German editor read it, laughed, unplugged his toaster, and published it anyway, adding dry notes wherever the author goes too far. Inside: • The 30-day plan for your analog fortress, Faraday trash can included • Seven tests that expose any deepfake, including the sniff test • Why a vinyl record, a pocket mirror, and a raincoat lined with foil beat any gadget • Scenario cards: the drone that rings politely, the fridge that locks the kitchen, the neighbor who suddenly speaks without an accent • AI slang for preppers, eighteen incident logs, and an illustrated field guide to copy by hand Yes, this is satire. It's a comedy disguised as a survival manual, about smart devices, chatbots, and our own gullibility. The few real-world tips (water storage, emergency numbers, a family code word) are marked and checked. Everything about 2032 is made up. Probably.
